arStrings.szText: {c_important}Boulder{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_22}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to the first enemy hit. This bonus is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|x%|]{/c} for each subsequent enemy hit afterward.

{c_important}Boulder{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill that costs {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} Spirit, has no Cooldown, and may be cast while moving.

{c_important}Boulder{/c} now orbits you. You may have max {c_number}5{/c} {c_important}Boulders{/c} orbiting at once.
{c_important}Boulder{/c} can now be cast at the target location. {c_important}Boulder{/c} deals {c_number}[(SF_32 * 100)|%|]{/c} bonus damage to the enemy it lands on.

{c_important}Boulder{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_36}*100|+%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance. Additionally, {c_important}Boulder{/c} gains an extra {c_number}[{SF_37}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance per stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u} active.
{c_important}Boulder{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_38}*100|%|]{/c} chance to launch an additional {c_important}Boulder{/c} for free.
Enemies hit by {c_important}Boulder{/c} are Slowed by {c_number}[{SF_39}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_40}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Boulder{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_41}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life as {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} ({c_number}{fortified:UPGRADE4_FORTIFY}{/c}) when it successfully hits a target.
